Part of #438 · slice s1 of 4 · into `feat/app-sidebar`

Every app page (`/app`, `/prd`, `/ask`, `/knowledge`) now sits in one `AppShell`. It has a left sidebar: the Work group (Home, PRDs, Questions with For me and History, Knowledge, Fleets) and the Omni group (Docs ↗, Release notes ↗). The sidebar marks the current item and shows the For me badge. The top bar shows the page's title, Omni/Light/Dark and Game mode. `AskBar`, the ask bar's links, `/knowledge`'s own bar and `/app`'s section cards (`Cards.tsx`, `SECTIONS`) are gone. The viewer is read once per request and never throws.

**Verified:** `pnpm test` is green (354 files, 5438 tests), and so is `omni check all`. `omni check coverage` finds 0 risky changes. `tsc --noEmit` for `apps/galaxy` shows only the 3 errors that `/docs` already had, from the ungenerated `.source` folder. A local `next dev` served all the app routes and the public ones with status 200. Each app page showed the right title, and the sidebar marked exactly one item current. The manual browser pass (three themes, 375px) was not run: the phone drawer belongs to s3.
**Decisions:** s1-01 (the fleets render test now checks the sidebar item: it was outside the territory), s1-02 (the knowledge repository chip sits in a heading row above the map), s1-03 (the demo viewer is signed in as the demo player). All three are medium and open.

data.title: feat(galaxy): app sidebar navigation
data.body:
Closes #438

## Slices

- [x] #449 s1: Every app page sits in one AppShell: the left sidebar (Work, Omni) and the top bar (title, theme, Game mode). The old bars, bar links and /app cards go
- [x] #456 s2: The top bar ends with you: the avatar menu (name, Sign out), or Sign in with GitHub
- [x] #458 s3: Below 900px, ☰ in the top bar opens the sidebar as a drawer
- [x] #457 s4: The public bar on /docs and /releases drops PRDs from its menu and gains Open the app →

## Summary

The app pages (`/app`, `/prd`, `/ask`, `/knowledge`) now sit in one **AppShell**:

- **Left sidebar.** **Work** has Home, PRDs, Questions (For me with its badge, History), Knowledge and Fleets. **Omni** has Docs ↗ and Release notes ↗. The current item is marked with `aria-current` (s1, #449).
- **Top bar.** It shows the page's title, Omni/Light/Dark and Game mode. It ends with you: the avatar opens a menu with your name, your @login and Sign out, following the WAI-ARIA menu-button keys; Sign out lands on `/`. Signed out, **Sign in with GitHub** takes its place (s2, #456).
- **Below 900px.** The sidebar hides and ☰ opens it as a drawer with its focus trapped inside. Escape, a tap on the scrim or choosing an item closes it. The theme switch and Game mode wrap to a second row (s3, #458).
- **Removed.** The old app bars, the ask bar links and `/app`'s section cards are gone.
- **Public bar.** On `/docs` and `/releases` its menu holds only Release notes and Docs, and it gains **Open the app →** (s4, #457).

The feature branch was brought up to date with `main` twice: after PRD 400 (fleets) landed, then after PRD 426 and PRD 451. The only conflict was in `apps/galaxy/src/dossier/page/page.test.ts`, two test fields; both are kept.

## Verified

- `pnpm test` (the preflight) on the finished feature branch, after the last merge of `main`: green, 366 files, 5642 tests.
- `node .omni-loop/bin/omni.mjs check all` (kb, releases, coverage): green.
- `node .omni-loop/bin/omni.mjs plan check 438`: green.
- s3 was checked by hand with Playwright on a local dev server: at 375px in all three themes on the seven app pages, with no sideways scroll and the drawer opening and closing; at 1280px the sidebar shows and ☰ is hidden.
- Not run: a browser pass of the signed-in user menu, done by keyboard only and on a real phone. Vercel previews answer 401, so it needs a local run. `tsc --noEmit` for `apps/galaxy` still shows only the `.source` errors `/docs` already had; the preflight does not run it. Acceptance is disabled in this repository.
- One test run, of two, failed on `kit/bin/ask.test.mjs` with a timeout (5.7s against 5s) while other sessions loaded the machine. This PRD changes no kit code, and the file passed alone and on every later run.

## Risk and rollback

A merge redeploys the galaxy app only. It includes no migration and no change to the kit or the GitHub App. To roll back, revert this PR's merge commit.

Territory breaches, all in tests: `apps/galaxy/src/fleets/render.test.ts` (s1), and `apps/galaxy/src/switch/headers.test.ts` (s2 and s3). Each is recorded as an adopted outbox item.

## Reviewer focus

- Sign-out and the user menu: the only way to switch account outside the game.
- `viewer.ts` falls back to the signed-out view when a read fails.
- Every app route's layout changes at once. Check them by hand on a local run, because Vercel previews answer 401.

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+---
+id: s3-01-headers-test-phone-controls
+prd: 438
+slice: s3
+rank: medium
+bears-on: none
+raised: 2026-09-28
+wave: 3
+---
+
+## The question, in plain words
+
+The phone menu button and the small logo now open the app's top bar, so the shared check that reads every app page's top bar had to learn about them. That check belongs to other parts of this work: may this part change it?
+
+## The decision, in plain words
+
+I changed that one check so it expects the menu button and the logo first, then the theme switch and Game mode as before. Nothing else in it moved.
+
+## The intro, for fun
+
+Two new buttons walked into the top bar and the bouncer had a list.
+
+## The punchline, for fun
+
+We added their names to the list rather than hide them in the coat room.
+
+## The options, in plain words
+
+A. Keep the menu button and the logo at the start of the top bar, and let the shared check expect them (built).
+B. Move them after the rest of the bar in the page and place them on the left by layout only, so the shared check stays untouched; keyboard order would then differ from what is seen.
+C. Draw the phone's first row outside the top bar, as a separate strip that only phones see.
+
+## What I had to decide
+
+Whether the shared page-header check may name the phone menu button and the logo, or whether they should live somewhere the check does not read.
+
+## What I did meanwhile
+
+The check expects the menu button and the logo before the theme switch; on a computer both stay hidden, on a phone they open the bar.
+
+## What it costs to change later
+
+Undoing it is two lines in one test file.
+
+## What I could not know
+
+(author) The PRD, the registers and the glossary do not settle this:
+
+- None: the plan names the shared check as the other slices' ground, and says nothing on whether this slice may extend it (author).
